text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Brian-san. Did you need Maya for 
something today?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Hold it in, hold it in~. Adults\ndon't go 
out of their way to bring up their own 
birthdays.\nUgh... but still...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And after I finally grew a year older, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, was it your 
birthday...? I don't have anything to give 
you, though...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
!! Y-Yeah! That's right! You remembered, 
Brian-san! Maya's so surprised!
